# Scripting

## Documentation

- [AppIntent](/guide/AppIntent.md): This interface serves as the core mechanism for executing script logic behind controls in Widgets, Live Activities, and ControlWidgets.
- [Assistant Conversation APIs](/guide/Assistant/Assistant Conversation APIs.md): The Conversation APIs are used to start, control, and present a system-hosted Assistant chat session.
- [Assistant Quick Start](/guide/Assistant/Assistant Quick Start.md): Quickly master the use of Assistant.
- [requestStreaming](/guide/Assistant/requestStreaming.md): Requests a streaming response from the Assistant.
- [requestStructuredData](/guide/Assistant/requestStructuredData.md): Request structured JSON data.
- [Intent](/guide/Changelog/2.4.8/Intent.md): New Intent.view method for returning custom UI to Shortcuts.
- [LanguageModelSession](/guide/Changelog/2.4.8/LanguageModelSession.md): It allows scripts to perform on-device AI tasks such as text generation, structured JSON output, and streaming responses.
- [Reminder](/guide/Changelog/2.4.8/Reminder.md): Adjusted Reminder.calendar property, which may be null if the user's device has not set a default calendar for reminders. It is recommended to specify a calendar when creating a Reminder instance.
- [Rich Text](/guide/Changelog/2.4.8/Rich Text.md): Added StyledText.paragraphStyle property.
- [Slider](/guide/Changelog/2.4.8/Slider/index.md): Added sliderThumbVisibility property.
- [Example](/guide/Changelog/2.4.8/Slider/index_example.md): Added sliderThumbVisibility property.
- [Assistant Tool With Interactive UI](/guide/Changelog/2.4.9/Assistant Tool With Interactive UI.md): Learn how to build interactive Assistant Tools using registerUIView and return structured output.
- [CalendarEvent](/guide/Changelog/2.4.9/CalendarEvent.md): Added CalendarEvent.get method to get a specific CalendarEvent by ID.
- [HeadphoneMotionManager](/guide/Changelog/2.4.9/HeadphoneMotionManager.md): Stream attitude, rotation rate, user acceleration, gravity, and connection events from spatial-audio headphones (AirPods Pro / Max / 3) on iOS 14+.
- [JWT](/guide/Changelog/2.4.9/JWT.md): Added synchronous JWT APIs for signing, verifying, and decoding tokens, with support for HS/RS/PS/ES/EdDSA algorithms and standard claim validation.
- [MediaLibrary](/guide/Changelog/2.4.9/MediaLibrary.md): Read local media library metadata, including songs, albums, artists, playlists, and artwork.
- [Reminder](/guide/Changelog/2.4.9/Reminder.md): Added Reminder.get method to get a specific Reminder by ID.
- [Script Minimization and Resume](/guide/Changelog/2.4.9/Script Minimization and Resume.md): These APIs allow a script running on iPhone to hide its UI without terminating the script instance, and to listen for resume or re-trigger events while the instance remains alive.
- [SystemMusicPlayer](/guide/Changelog/2.4.9/SystemMusicPlayer.md): Control the system music player.
- [TextField textContentType](/guide/Changelog/2.4.9/TextField textContentType.md): Added textContentType modifier for TextField to provide semantic input hints and autofill behavior.
- [WebScraper](/guide/Changelog/2.4.9/WebScraper.md): Extract data from web pages.
- [Alarm Live Activity](/guide/Changelog/3.0.0/Alarm/Alarm Live Activity/index.md): Register a custom Lock Screen and Dynamic Island UI for AlarmKit alarms.
- [AlarmManager](/guide/Changelog/3.0.0/Alarm/AlarmManager.md): For creating and managing AlarmKit-based alarms, timers, and countdown reminders.
- [FileManager](/guide/Changelog/3.0.0/FileManager.md): Add webDAVDocumentsDirectory and isWebDAVAvailable properties.
- [TranslationUIProvider](/guide/Changelog/3.0.0/TranslationUIProvider.md): This interface allows scripts to take control of the system translation panel’s UI and interaction flow.
- [](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/AVAsset Reader / Writer / Export.md)
- [AVAsset](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/AVAsset.md): A handle to a media asset for loading metadata / tracks and extracting still frames without an AVPlayer.
- [Camera Control (iOS 18+)](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/AVCaptureSession & Camera Control/Camera Control (iOS 18+).md): AVCaptureSlider, AVCaptureIndexPicker, system zoom / exposure sliders, and AVCaptureEventInteraction for the iPhone 16 hardware button.
- [CaptureVideoPreviewView](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/AVCaptureSession & Camera Control/CaptureVideoPreviewView.md): Render the live preview of any AVCaptureSession in a SwiftUI view with rotation coordination.
- [Device formats](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/AVCaptureSession & Camera Control/Device formats/index.md): List and switch AVCaptureDeviceFormat (resolution, fps, HDR, multi-cam, spatial video, stabilization); pick a color space via setActiveColorSpace; lock frame-rate ceiling/floor via setActiveVideoMin/MaxFrameDuration.
- [Example](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/AVCaptureSession & Camera Control/Device formats/index_example.md): List and switch AVCaptureDeviceFormat (resolution, fps, HDR, multi-cam, spatial video, stabilization); pick a color space via setActiveColorSpace; lock frame-rate ceiling/floor via setActiveVideoMin/MaxFrameDuration.
- [Live Photo](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/AVCaptureSession & Camera Control/Live Photo/index.md): Pass `livePhotoMovieFile` to capturePhoto and resolve with both the still image and the .mov companion clip.
- [Example](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/AVCaptureSession & Camera Control/Live Photo/index_example.md): Pass `livePhotoMovieFile` to capturePhoto and resolve with both the still image and the .mov companion clip.
- [Quick Start](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/AVCaptureSession & Camera Control/Quick Start/index.md): Build a session, scan QR codes, capture photos, render the preview, and tear it down. Self-contained demo.
- [Example](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/AVCaptureSession & Camera Control/Quick Start/index_example.md): Build a session, scan QR codes, capture photos, render the preview, and tear it down. Self-contained demo.
- [Responsive capture](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/AVCaptureSession & Camera Control/Responsive capture/index.md): Zero Shutter Lag, Responsive Capture, Fast Prioritization, and Auto Deferred Photo Delivery — what each does and when (not) to enable it.
- [Example](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/AVCaptureSession & Camera Control/Responsive capture/index_example.md): Zero Shutter Lag, Responsive Capture, Fast Prioritization, and Auto Deferred Photo Delivery — what each does and when (not) to enable it.

- [VideoRecorder vs AVCaptureSession](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/AVCaptureSession & Camera Control/VideoRecorder vs AVCaptureSession.md): When to reach for the high-level VideoRecorder vs the low-level AVCaptureSession pipeline.
- [AVPlayer](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/AVPlayer.md): Add options parameter to setSource method, to configure request headers.
- [AudioCapture](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/AudioCapture.md): Real-time microphone capture exposing raw PCM frames, RMS / peak levels, and YIN-based pitch estimates. Suitable for tuners, waveform views, and custom DSP. Optionally writes a wav file.
- [](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/AudioRecorder (Level Metering).md)
- [Canvas (Web 2D drawing context)](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Canvas (Web 2D drawing context)/index.md): A SwiftUI-backed view with a Web-Canvas-style imperative 2D drawing API.
- [Example](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Canvas (Web 2D drawing context)/index_example.md): A SwiftUI-backed view with a Web-Canvas-style imperative 2D drawing API.
- [](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Chart: LinePlot & AreaPlot (function curves)/index.md)
- [Example](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Chart: LinePlot & AreaPlot (function curves)/index_example.md): iOS 18+ LinePlot / AreaPlot mark types — plot smooth curves and areas straight from a JS function. Supports single-variable y=f(x), parametric (x,y)=f(t), and AreaPlot (yStart,yEnd)=f(x).
- [](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Chart: gesture, overlay & styling/index.md)
- [Example](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Chart: gesture, overlay & styling/index_example.md): ChartGesture (custom gestures + ChartProxy.select* for programmatic selection), ChartPlotStyle (plot-area background / border / frame builder), ChartAxisLabelFormat (currency / number / date precision factories), and per-mark VoiceOver fields (accessibilityLabel / Value / Hidden).
- [](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Chart: legend control/index.md)
- [Example](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Chart: legend control/index_example.md): chartLegend accepts a Visibility string ("automatic" / "visible" / "hidden") to keep or remove the auto-generated legend, or an object ({ position, alignment?, spacing?, content? }) to reposition or fully customize it.
- [](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Chart: scroll target behavior/index.md)
- [Example](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Chart: scroll target behavior/index_example.md): chartScrollTargetBehavior(.valueAligned) snaps chart scroll deceleration to data boundaries. Pick unit step for numeric axes or matching DateComponents for date axes; majorAlignment controls the secondary 'page' snap.
- [Custom Keyboard](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Custom Keyboard.md): Keyboard scripts can list available keyboard scripts and switch directly with CustomKeyboard.allScripts, switchToScript(scriptName, queryParameters?), and nextScript(queryParameters?).
- [](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Device (Python).md)
- [](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Dialog (Python).md)
- [Github API](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Github API.md): This interface is used to call Github API.
- [Haptics](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Haptics/index.md): Create and play custom Core Haptics patterns with engines, events, parameters, players, and AHAP data.
- [Example](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Haptics/index_example.md): Create and play custom Core Haptics patterns with engines, events, parameters, players, and AHAP data.
- [ImageIO](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/ImageIO.md): Read / write image metadata (EXIF / GPS / TIFF / IPTC) and encode formats UIImage can't (HEIC / TIFF / GIF).
- [Location](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Location/index.md): Heading stream APIs (requestHeading / startUpdatingHeading / addHeadingListener / removeHeadingListener), continuous location stream APIs (startUpdatingLocation / stopUpdatingLocation / addLocationListener / removeLocationListener), an optional requestAlwaysAuthorization flag on startUpdating*, CLLocationManager passthrough properties (allowsBackgroundLocationUpdates / pausesLocationUpdatesAutomatically / showsBackgroundLocationIndicator / distanceFilter / headingFilter / activityType), and the streaming Promise now resolves with the authorization mode actually granted.
- [Example](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Location/index_example.md): Heading stream APIs (requestHeading / startUpdatingHeading / addHeadingListener / removeHeadingListener), continuous location stream APIs (startUpdatingLocation / stopUpdatingLocation / addLocationListener / removeLocationListener), an optional requestAlwaysAuthorization flag on startUpdating*, CLLocationManager passthrough properties (allowsBackgroundLocationUpdates / pausesLocationUpdatesAutomatically / showsBackgroundLocationIndicator / distanceFilter / headingFilter / activityType), and the streaming Promise now resolves with the authorization mode actually granted.

- [Contextual Embedding](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/NaturalLanguage/Contextual Embedding.md): Transformer-style sequence embeddings.
- [Embedding](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/NaturalLanguage/Embedding.md): Built-in word and sentence vectors for similarity, neighbors, distance.
- [Gazetteer](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/NaturalLanguage/Gazetteer.md): User-supplied lexicon that overrides the system tagger for custom vocabularies.
- [Language Recognition](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/NaturalLanguage/Language Recognition.md): Detect the dominant language or rank candidates by confidence.
- [Tagger](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/NaturalLanguage/Tagger.md): Part-of-speech, lemma, named-entity, sentiment, custom tags from gazetteers.
- [Tokenizer](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/NaturalLanguage/Tokenizer.md): Split text into words, sentences, paragraphs, or documents.
- [Path2D (SwiftUI Path)](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Path2D (SwiftUI Path)/index.md): A SwiftUI-`Path`-style vector path you build, render with `<PathShape>`, query, or use as a clip shape.

- [Example](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Photos/index_example.md): Add new PHAssetCollection, PHAsset APIs.
- [Python](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Python.md): Run Python code snippets from JS / TS via the embedded Python interpreter; shares a serial queue with Shell.run.
- [Redirect Rules](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Redirect Rules.md): Rewrite matching URLs in Safari and redirect to another address.
- [Remote Push](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Remote Push.md): Send push notifications to your own devices from your servers and automations using an API key.

- [Safari Browser Scripts](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Safari Browser Scripts.md): Run userscripts in Safari, use GM APIs, and access Scripting.FileManager.
- [Script (Python)](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Script (Python).md): Python index scripts can now read Script.name / queryParameters / metadata / directory and call Script.run / Script.exit, mirroring the JS-side Script global.
- [](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/ScrollView: scroll position & visibility tracking/index.md)
- [Example](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/ScrollView: scroll position & visibility tracking/index_example.md): scrollPosition(id:anchor:) two-way binds the leading visible item's id to JS state on plain ScrollView (no ScrollViewReader needed). onScrollTargetVisibilityChange (iOS 18+) reports the full visible-id set as you scroll. Children mark themselves with key={...} (mapped to SwiftUI .id()) and the layout container needs scrollTargetLayout.
- [Search Shortcuts](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Search Shortcuts.md): Type a trigger word in Safari's address bar to jump to a site's search.
- [](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/SharedAudioSession.md)
- [Shell](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Shell.md): Run shell commands from JS / TS via the embedded ios_system runtime, with support for cwd, timeout, env, and queryParameters.
- [Speech (SSML)](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Speech (SSML).md): Added isSSML option to Speech.speak / Speech.synthesizeToFile for SSML input on iOS 16+.
- [SpeechRecognition](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/SpeechRecognition.md): Recognition results expose more fields, and start() accepts a new preferredInput option to force the built-in microphone.
- [Spotlight](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Spotlight.md): Index script-defined items into system Spotlight and handle taps with spotlight.tsx through Spotlight.current.
- [Storage (Python)](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/Storage (Python).md): Python-side persistent key-value storage with per-script and shared namespaces, sharing the underlying store with the JS-side Storage namespace.
- [](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/symbolEffect: drawOn / drawOff + isActive + options/index.md)
- [Example](/guide/Changelog/3.1.0/symbolEffect: drawOn / drawOff + isActive + options/index_example.md): iOS 26 / SF Symbols 7 introduces drawOn and drawOff symbol animations. The bridge now exposes them via the `isActive` trigger form (mirrors SwiftUI symbolEffect(_:options:isActive:)) — flip a bool to draw the symbol on or off. The new SymbolEffectOptions (speed / repeat / nonRepeating) is also wired through, and isActive is opened up for the existing appear / disappear / scale effects. Silent fallback on iOS < 26 for drawOn/drawOff.

- [DocumentInteraction](/guide/Changelog/3.2.0/DocumentInteraction/index.md): Present the system "Open in…" menu so the user can pick an app to open a file with.

- [AVMetadataItem](/guide/Device Capabilities/AVMetadataItem.md): AVMetadataItem is a class that represents a metadata item in an audio or video asset.
- [AVPlayer](/guide/Device Capabilities/AVPlayer.md): The interface for playing audio or video resources, supporting playback control, rate control, loop playback, playback status listening, and media metadata reading.
- [AppStore](/guide/Device Capabilities/AppStore.md): This API is used to display the details of an app in the App Store, without leaving the Scripting app.
- [AudioRecorder](/guide/Device Capabilities/AudioRecorder.md): The interface allows you to record audio data to a file. It provides functionalities to start, stop, pause, and manage audio recordings, with configurable settings for audio quality, sample rate, format, and more.
- [BackgroundKeeper](/guide/Device Capabilities/BackgroundKeeper.md): This interface provides methods for keeping the Scripting app running in the background.
- [BluetoothCentralManager](/guide/Device Capabilities/Bluetooth/BluetoothCentralManager.md): This interface allows you to scan for, connect to, and interact with nearby Bluetooth peripherals.
- [BluetoothCharacteristic](/guide/Device Capabilities/Bluetooth/BluetoothCharacteristic.md): This interface represents a Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) service. A service is a logical grouping of related characteristics and possibly other included services.
- [BluetoothPeripheral](/guide/Device Capabilities/Bluetooth/BluetoothPeripheral.md): This interface provides properties and methods for interacting with the device, including connecting, discovering services and characteristics, reading/writing values, and subscribing to notifications.
- [BluetoothPeripheralManager](/guide/Device Capabilities/Bluetooth/BluetoothPeripheralManager.md): This interface allows you to create a Bluetooth peripheral that can advertise services and characteristics, and accept connections from central devices.
- [BluetoothService](/guide/Device Capabilities/Bluetooth/BluetoothService.md): This interface represents a Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) service. A service is a logical grouping of related characteristics and possibly other included services.
- [Calendar](/guide/Device Capabilities/Calendar.md): This interface allows you to interact with iOS calendars, enabling operations like retrieving default calendars, creating custom calendars, and managing calendar settings and events.
- [CalendarEvent](/guide/Device Capabilities/CalendarEvent.md): This interface enables you to create and manage events in iOS calendars, with properties like title, location, dates, attendees, and recurrence.
- [Contact](/guide/Device Capabilities/Contact/index.md): This interface allows you to access and manage contacts on the device. You can create, query, update, and delete contacts, as well as manage contact groups and containers.
- [Example](/guide/Device Capabilities/Contact/index_example.md): This interface allows you to access and manage contacts on the device. You can create, query, update, and delete contacts, as well as manage contact groups and containers.
- [Device](/guide/Device Capabilities/Device/index.md): Provides the information abouts the device, also some methods to use the capabilities of the device.
- [Example](/guide/Device Capabilities/Device/index_example.md): Provides the information abouts the device, also some methods to use the capabilities of the device.
- [DocumentInteraction](/guide/Device Capabilities/DocumentInteraction/index.md): Present the system "Open in…" menu so the user can pick an app to open a file with.
- [Example](/guide/Device Capabilities/DocumentInteraction/index_example.md): Present the system "Open in…" menu so the user can pick an app to open a file with.
- [DocumentPicker](/guide/Device Capabilities/DocumentPicker.md): Pick files from Files app.
- [EventAlarm](/guide/Device Capabilities/EventAlarm.md): This class represents a reminder rule that can be attached to both CalendarEvent and Reminder objects.
- [FontPicker](/guide/Device Capabilities/FontPicker.md): This namespace provides methods for selecting fonts from the system’s available font list.
- [HapticFeedback](/guide/Device Capabilities/HapticFeedback.md): Haptic feedback provides a tactile response, such as a tap, that draws attention and reinforces both actions and events.
- [HealthActivitySummary](/guide/Device Capabilities/Health/HealthActivitySummary.md): Represents a summary of daily activity, including steps taken, distance traveled, and calories burned.
- [HealthCategorySample](/guide/Device Capabilities/Health/HealthCategorySample.md): Represents a health category sample, such as sleep analysis, menstrual flow, ovulation test results, etc.
- [HealthCategoryType](/guide/Device Capabilities/Health/HealthCategoryType.md): This interface provides a way to define and manage health category types, which represent qualitative health data such as sleep analysis, mood, or menstrual cycle.
- [HealthCategoryValue Types](/guide/Device Capabilities/Health/HealthCategoryValue Types.md): This interface provides a way to define and manage health category value types, which represent specific values for health category data such as sleep stages or mood states.
- [HealthCharacteristicType](/guide/Device Capabilities/Health/HealthCharacteristicType.md): An enumeration of health characteristics such as biological sex, blood type, skin type, wheelchair use, and activity mobility patterns.
- [HealthCorrelation](/guide/Device Capabilities/Health/HealthCorrelation.md): Represents a health correlation, which is a relationship between two or more health data samples, such as blood pressure readings and heart rate.
- [HealthHeartbeatSeriesSample](/guide/Device Capabilities/Health/HealthHeartbeatSeriesSample.md): Represents a series of heartbeat samples, which can be used to analyze heart rate variability or other cardiac metrics.
- [HealthKit Permission Behavior](/guide/Device Capabilities/Health/HealthKit Permission Behavior.md): iOS HealthKit-specific permission behavior.
- [HealthQuantitySample](/guide/Device Capabilities/Health/HealthQuantitySample.md): Represents a health quantity sample, such as a heart rate measurement, recorded steps, or calories consumed.
- [HealthQuantityType](/guide/Device Capabilities/Health/HealthQuantityType.md): This interface provides a way to define and manage health quantity types, which represent measurable health data such as steps, heart rate, or calories burned.
- [HealthStatistics](/guide/Device Capabilities/Health/HealthStatistics.md): This interface provides a way to calculate statistics for health data, such as average, minimum, maximum, and sum for health quantity samples.
- [HealthStatisticsCollection](/guide/Device Capabilities/Health/HealthStatisticsCollection.md): This interface provides a way to collect and manage statistics for health data over a specified time period, such as average, minimum, maximum, and sum for health quantity samples.

- [flipsForRightToLeftLayoutDirection](/guide/View Modifiers/flipsForRightToLeftLayoutDirection.md): Determines whether the view should horizontally mirror its contents when the system layout direction is right-to-left (RTL).
- [foregroundStyle & background](/guide/View Modifiers/foregroundStyle & background.md): These two properties allow you to customize the visual styling of view content and its background.
- [formStyle](/guide/View Modifiers/formStyle.md): The formStyle property allows you to customize the appearance and interaction of the Form view.
- [frame](/guide/View Modifiers/frame.md): This property defines the size and alignment of a view.
- [gaugeStyle](/guide/View Modifiers/gaugeStyle.md): The gaugeStyle property allows you to customize the appearance and interaction of the Gauge view.
- [hidden](/guide/View Modifiers/hidden.md): Sets the visibility of a view.
- [labelsHidden](/guide/View Modifiers/labelsHidden.md): Hides the labels of controls contained within the view.
- [layoutDirectionBehavior](/guide/View Modifiers/layoutDirectionBehavior.md): Controls how a view mirrors its contents for left-to-right and right-to-left layout directions.
- [layoutPriority](/guide/View Modifiers/layoutPriority.md): This view modifier specifies a layout priority for a view.
- [listStyle](/guide/View Modifiers/listStyle.md): The listStyle property allows you to customize the behavior and appearance of a list in your UI when using the List view.
- [mask](/guide/View Modifiers/mask.md): This view modifier clips the visual rendering of a view using the **alpha channel** of another view.
- [matchedGeometryEffect](/guide/View Modifiers/matchedGeometryEffect.md): This view modifier establishes a geometric relationship between different views, allowing them to animate smoothly when transitioning across different layouts, different containers, different conditional render states, different size and position configurations.
- [matchedTransitionSource](/guide/View Modifiers/matchedTransitionSource.md): This view modifier marks a view as the geometric source of a navigation transition.
- [offset](/guide/View Modifiers/offset.md): Moves the view from its original position by the specified x and y distances.
- [onDrag and onDrop View Modifiers](/guide/View Modifiers/onDrag and onDrop View Modifiers.md): These APIs enable views to act as drag sources, drop destinations, or both, supporting intra-app and cross-app drag-and-drop scenarios.
- [onDropContent](/guide/View Modifiers/onDropContent.md): The view modifier allows a view in your script to act as a drop target, accepting files, images, or text dragged in from other apps.
- [opacity](/guide/View Modifiers/opacity.md): Sets the transparency level of a view.
- [overlay](/guide/View Modifiers/overlay.md): This view modifier places a view on top of the modified view, creating a layered composition.
- [padding](/guide/View Modifiers/padding.md): This property adds space around the content of a view.
- [pickerStyle](/guide/View Modifiers/pickerStyle.md): The pickerStyle property allows you to customize the appearance and behavior of pickers within a view hierarchy.
- [position](/guide/View Modifiers/position.md): Positions the center of the view at the given x and y coordinates within its parent’s coordinate space.
- [preferredColorScheme](/guide/View Modifiers/preferredColorScheme.md): Sets the preferred system appearance (light or dark) for the view hierarchy.
- [progressViewStyle](/guide/View Modifiers/progressViewStyle.md): The progressViewStyle property allows you to customize the appearance of a progress view.
- [refresable](/guide/View Modifiers/refresable/index.md): Marks a scrollable view as refreshable, enabling the user to pull down to trigger an asynchronous data reload.
- [Example](/guide/View Modifiers/refresable/refreshable_list.md): Marks a scrollable view as refreshable, enabling the user to pull down to trigger an asynchronous data reload.
- [rotationEffect](/guide/View Modifiers/rotationEffect.md): Rotates the view by a specified angle in degrees.
- [scaleEffect](/guide/View Modifiers/scaleEffect.md): Scales the view horizontally and vertically.
- [shadow](/guide/View Modifiers/shadow.md): Applies a shadow behind the view.
- [textFieldStyle](/guide/View Modifiers/textFieldStyle.md): The textFieldStyle property allows you to customize the appearance and interaction of the TextField view.
- [tint](/guide/View Modifiers/tint.md): Overrides the default accent color for a specific view using a given style.
- [toggleStyle](/guide/View Modifiers/toggleStyle.md): The toggleStyle property allows you to customize the appearance and interaction of the Toggle view.
